steps.text:
I built the black-and-gold nominee board for your film festival awards night. It passes the checker with no errors or warnings. I also went through every coverage frame from the Take to Out, and I'd put it on air as it is. Nothing was saved to NoaCG from here; the host saves the version I handed in.

**How it looks:** a centred black board with a thin double gold frame. The kicker ("THE NOMINEES") is in spaced gold capitals, the category is in a classic serif, and a gold rule fades out at both ends. Each nominee has the director's name above the film title in gold italics. The board is nearly opaque and has a soft dark halo, so text stays readable over the bright LED wall. The stage camera stays visible around it.

**What you change per award:**
- **Category** – e.g. "Best Short Film".
- **Kicker** – "THE NOMINEES".
- **Nominees** – one per line, written as `Director | Film title`.
- **Winner** – the row number, 1 to 4.

**These are your buttons:**
| Button | What it does |
|---|---|
| ⚡ **Suspense** | All nominees dim and the board swells slightly while the host builds up |
| ⚡ **Reveal winner** | The winning row lights up gold with a gold frame; the others fade back but stay read...
